name: Downset Filter
definition: If $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^X$ is downward closed in $U\subseteq X$ and $D\subseteq\{0,1\}^U$ is a nonempty downset, the downset filter is $C|_D=\{x\in C:x|_U\in D\}$.
comments: The operation retains the positioned coordinates. Its hypotheses include a common downward orientation on the constrained block.
